debate.key_bear_argument: Price structure completely broken (below EMA 9, 21, SMA 21), MACD deeply negative with no crossover, volume not confirming recovery (OBV flat/falling), three black crows pattern active, and macro environment hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, earnings risk in 39 days) — oversold conditions alone insufficient without confirmation.
